title: Combobox Group
description: A searchable combobox built with the single Combobox component that filters members and files with match-sorter, renders each result set in a labeled ComboboxGroup, and shows ComboboxEmpty when nothing matches. With autoSelect and autoComplete="both", typing completes the first match inline and arrow keys move across groups. Use it for grouped, filterable results with plain text options, rather than Custom Items for avatars or descriptions.
